novel_features.name: Capability+budget model ranker
novel_features.description: Rank every image model+provider combo cheapest-first under your capability and budget constraints.
novel_features.rationale: Requires joining model capability descriptors against per-provider pricing lines in the local store; no single API call returns this ranking.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Pick the cheapest provider that meets your image constraints without paging through catalog JSON.

novel_features.name: Budget-gated batch run
novel_features.description: Run many generations from a CSV with a hard USD budget: estimate first, abort before any spend if over, then execute and log each cost.
novel_features.rationale: Estimates every row from local pricing before the first API call and gates execution on the budget, a loop no endpoint offers.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Cron pipelines can fire a batch with a hard spend cap and get typed exit codes instead of burning the whole balance.

novel_features.name: Pre-spend cost estimate
novel_features.description: Estimate USD cost of a generation before spending credits, computed offline from synced per-endpoint pricing.
novel_features.rationale: Computes from synced pricing lines and resolution tiers in the local store with no API call.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Agents can check the price of a planned image before spending credits.

novel_features.name: Deterministic re-generation
novel_features.description: Re-run a past generation with its exact stored parameters (model, seed, resolution, quality, references).
novel_features.rationale: Rebuilds the request from the local generation ledger, replay power only a local history store provides.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reproduce or tweak a past image without re-typing the full flag set.

novel_features.name: Catalog change diff
novel_features.description: See newly added, retired, and price-changed image models between syncs so pinned pipelines never break silently.
novel_features.rationale: Compares the current catalog snapshot against the stored previous snapshot in the local store.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Catch a retired model before the next scheduled batch 404s.

novel_features.name: Weekly spend digest
novel_features.description: Period-over-period spend and volume summary: images generated, USD spent, top models, cost per image vs the prior window.
novel_features.rationale: Self-joins the local generation ledger across two time windows, a trend no API call returns.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Budget owners get a machine-readable weekly cost report from the local ledger.

narrative.headline: Every image model on OpenRouter, one key: generate, rank, estimate, and batch with a local cost ledger.
narrative.value_prop: OpenRouter's Image API fronts 40+ image models from every major lab. This CLI adds what the API alone lacks: offline model ranking by capability and budget, pre-spend cost estimates, deterministic re-generation from a local history ledger, budget-gated batch runs, and a weekly spend digest. Model selection is always explicit — every generation names its model.
narrative.auth_narrative: Set OPENROUTER_API_KEY in your environment. The key is read per command; nothing is persisted to disk. Run `openrouter-image-pp-cli doctor` to verify setup.

quickstart.comment: Verify the CLI is installed and the key is wired up
Pull the image model catalog and per-endpoint pricing into the local store
Pick the cheapest provider that supports image-to-image under your budget
Check the price before spending credits

quickstart.command: openrouter-image-pp-cli generate --model openai/gpt-image-1 --prompt 'a red panda astronaut' --output panda.png
quickstart.comment: Generate an image and save it to disk
Review weekly spend and volume as agent-shaped JSON

troubleshoots.fix: Check OPENROUTER_API_KEY is set and valid; run `openrouter-image-pp-cli doctor`
Run `openrouter-image-pp-cli sync --resources images --full` then `openrouter-image-pp-cli models list` to see current slugs; models retire without notice
Use `batch --dry-run` first; the estimate comes from synced pricing, so re-sync before a big batch
OpenRouter throttles per-key; wait and retry, or route to another provider via `generate --provider`

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI when an AI agent or human needs to generate images on demand through OpenRouter with explicit model selection, wants to pick the cheapest capable provider before spending, run budgeted batches from a CSV, reproduce past generations exactly, or track image-generation spend over time. It is the tool for scheduled image pipelines, prompt iteration across models, and cost-aware image production.
anti_triggers: Do not use this CLI for chat completions or text generation — use the existing openrouter-pp-cli (cost attribution) or a chat CLI
Do not use this CLI for video generation — OpenRouter's video API is a different surface
Do not use this CLI for embedding, reranking, or speech endpoints
Do not use this CLI as a general HTTP client for arbitrary OpenRouter endpoints
